dao.title: Set up DAO
dao.description:
Open this link in a desktop browser and sign in at DAO: {authorize_url}

A desktop browser may not open the final daoapp:// redirect. That is expected. Copy its complete URL from the address bar and paste it below. See the [step-by-step instructions]({docs_url}). Home Assistant never receives your password.

reauth_confirm.title: DAO sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description:
DAO no longer accepts the saved session. Open this link, sign in again and paste the redirect URL from your browser: {authorize_url}

See the [step-by-step instructions]({docs_url}).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach DAO. Please try again.
error.paste_full_url: DAO could not find a code or state in that text — paste the whole address-bar URL after signing in, not just the code.

abort.already_configured: DAO's tracking-code source is already set up. Add codes to it instead of adding DAO again.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different DAO account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

data_description.tracking_codes: The DAO tracking code(s), as printed on the shipping confirmation or the parcel label. No account is needed to follow them.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a DAO parcel by its tracking code. Needs DAO's tracking-code source, not an account.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a DAO parcel by its tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The DAO tracking code to stop tracking.
